EDITORIAL PROFILE

A reusable liquidity and credit layer.

Aave is a decentralized lending protocol that lets users supply crypto assets, earn interest, and borrow against collateral without relying on a centralized intermediary. Its markets are built around shared pools of liquidity, with borrowing conditions and risk parameters set at the protocol level.

Aave has expanded beyond a simple lend-and-borrow interface into a broader credit layer that includes tools for developers, asset swaps, savings products, and newer market architecture in Aave v4. Even with that wider scope, lending remains the clearest way to understand the product: users deposit assets into onchain markets, while borrowers access liquidity against posted collateral.
